First Community Bankshares, Inc. Announces Record Third Quarter 2026 Results and Quarterly Cash Dividend

 

Bluefield, Virginia – First Community Bankshares, Inc. (NASDAQ: FCBC) (www.firstcommunitybank.com) (the “Company”) today reported its unaudited results of operations and other financial information for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The Company reported a quarterly net income of $15.42 million, or $0.81 per diluted common share, for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.  Net income for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, reached a record $49.96 million, with diluted earnings per common share of $2.63.

 

The Company also declared a quarterly cash dividend to common shareholders of thirty-three cents, $0.33, per common share. The quarterly dividend is payable to common shareholders of record on November 13, 2026, and is expected to be paid on November 27, 2026. This year marks the 41st consecutive year of regular dividends to common shareholders. 

 

Third Quarter 2026 Highlights

 

Income Statement

  

  o

Net income for the third quarter of 2026 increased $3.16 million, or 25.74%, to $15.42 million, compared with $12.27 million for the third quarter of 2025.  For the first nine months of 2026, net income reached a record $49.96 million, surpassing the previous nine-month record of $40.61 million reported in 2021 and increasing $13.63 million compared with the first nine months of 2025.
  o

Excluding merger-related and other non-recurring items, adjusted net income for the third quarter of 2026 was $14.74 million, an increase of $1.84 million, or 14.23%, from the same period in 2025. For the first nine months of 2026, adjusted net income totaled $42.79 million, an increase of $5.82 million, or 15.76%, compared to the same time period of 2025.  Significant non-recurring pre-tax items during 2026 included a $10.38 million gain on the sale of the Company's stake in Bearing Insurance and merger-related costs of $2.31 million.
  o Net interest margin increased 3 basis points to 4.46% for the third quarter of 2026, compared with 4.43% for the third quarter of 2025.  Net interest rate spread increased 10 basis points to 4.16%, contributing to a $4.62 million, or 14.72%, increase in tax-equivalent net interest income.  The improvement was primarily driven by an increase in average earning assets and lower funding costs.  Average earning assets increased $390.91 million, or 13.89%, contributing $4.56 million in additional interest income, while the cost of interest-bearing deposits declined 15 basis points.  
  o Net interest income after provision for loan losses increased $3.89 million, or 12.42%, compared with September 30, 2025. The increase was primarily attributable to growth in average earning assets associated with the acquisition of Hometown Bancshares, completed in the first quarter of 2026.
  o Noninterest income increased $1.76 million, or 16.14%, compared to the same quarter of 2025, primarily reflecting a combined $1.61 million increase in other operating income and other service charges and fees.  Noninterest expense increased $1.66 million, or 6.32%, over the same period, primarily due to increases in salaries and benefits of $955 thousand, or 6.66%, other operating expense of $471 thousand, or 13.95%, and amortization of intangibles of $401 thousand, or 92.61%.  
 

o

Annualized return on average assets ("ROA") increased to 1.69% for the third quarter of 2026, compared with 1.53% for the same quarter of 2025.  Annualized return on average common equity ("ROE") increased to 11.23%, compared with 9.58% for the same period of 2025. 
  o When adjusted for merger and non-recurring expenses, ROA was 1.62% for the third quarter of 2026 and ROE was 10.73%.  Return on average tangible common equity was 15.32%.

 

Balance Sheet and Asset Quality

 

  o Consolidated assets totaled $3.63 billion at September 30, 2026.
  o

The Company's loan portfolio increased $162.66 million, or 7.03% from year-end 2025.  Excluding the Hometown acquisition, the loan portfolio decreased approximately $8.38 million, or 0.36%.  However, loan production for the third quarter of 2026 was $125.59 million, compared to $88.84 million for the same quarter in 2025, a 41.37% increase. 
  o The allowance for credit losses increased $1.88 million in the third quarter of 2026 compared to December 31, 2025, primarily driven by the impact of the Hometown transaction. The allowance for credit losses to total loans was 1.32% on September 30, 2026, compared to 1.33% on December 31, 2025, and 1.36% on September 30, 2025.
  o

The Company did not repurchase any common shares in the third quarter of 2026 or 2025. However, 504,652 common shares at a total cost of $20.33 million were repurchased during the first quarter of 2026. 
  o Total non-performing assets declined $1.03 million, or 6.09%, compared to the same period of 2025, reflecting continued improvement in asset quality and the second consecutive quarterly decline. 
  o

Non-performing loans as a percentage of total loans improved to 0.64% on September 30, 2026, from 0.71% at September 30, 2025, a decrease of 7 basis points. Net charge-offs for the third quarter of 2026 totaled $696 thousand, or 0.11%, of annualized average loans, compared to $1.42 million, or 0.24%, of annualized average loans for the same period in 2025.  The year-over-year improvement was primarily attributable to $2.01 million of significant charge-offs recorded during the third quarter of 2025.
 

o

Book value per share on September 30, 2026, was $ 28.83, an increase of $1.53, or 5.60%, from year-end 2025.

Non-GAAP Financial Measures

 

In addition to financial statements prepared in accordance with U.S. generally accepted accounting principles (“GAAP”), the Company uses certain non-GAAP financial measures that provide useful information for financial and operational decision making, evaluating trends, and comparing financial results to other financial institutions. The non-GAAP financial measures presented in this news release include “tangible book value per common share,” “return on average tangible common equity,” “adjusted earnings,” “adjusted diluted earnings per share,” “adjusted return on average assets,” “adjusted return on average common equity,” “adjusted return on average tangible common equity,” and certain financial measures presented on a fully taxable equivalent (“FTE”) basis. FTE basis is calculated using the federal statutory income tax rate of 21%.  Where non-GAAP financial measures are used, the comparable GAAP financial measure, as well as a reconciliation to that comparable GAAP financial measure can be found in the attached tables to this press release.  While the Company believes certain non-GAAP financial measures enhance the understanding of its business and performance, they are supplemental and not a substitute for, or more important than, financial measures prepared in accordance with GAAP and may not be comparable to those reported by other financial institutions.

 

About First Community Bankshares, Inc.

 

First Community Bankshares, Inc., a financial holding company headquartered in Bluefield, Virginia, provides banking products and services through its wholly owned subsidiary First Community Bank. First Community Bank operated 61 branch banking locations in Virginia, West Virginia, North Carolina, and Tennessee as of September 30, 2026. First Community Bank offers wealth management and investment advice and services through its Trust Division and through its wholly owned subsidiary, First Community Wealth Management, which collectively managed and administered $1.82 billion in combined assets as of September 30, 2026. The Company reported consolidated assets of $3.63 billion as of September 30, 2026. The Company’s common stock is listed on the NASDAQ Global Select Market under the trading symbol, “FCBC”. Additional investor information is available on the Company’s website at www.firstcommunitybank.com.
